title: "she's down for her nap now" with two visible nap events for the SAME child and currentChild asserted -> tiebreak then dedup collapse to one candidate, resolved binding via currentChild, never a 1-option question
contractSource: art_gCDrtx4S section 5, F-AX-CLARIFY-001 — dedup-before-count refinement (PR #28 review finding F1)

scenario.narrative: Mom dictates 'she's down for her nap now' with the child picker set to Mia (currentChild asserted) and two visible nap events in references - both bound to Mia. The currentChild tiebreak keeps both child-kind candidates (both match), then the kind:targetId dedup collapses them to a single candidate BEFORE the count checks. One candidate resolves through the currentChild binding path: provenance is the currentChild's source and the basis names the tiebreak and the first via reference - never a clarification question with a single option (the schema pins clarification options to 2-4).
